text: The purpose of this report is to provide the results of a Traffic Control Signal Warrant study at the intersection of North Queen Street and Vansco Road. Since the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) provides service on North Queen Street, City Council approval of this report is required. TTC staff has not been advised of the signal installation studies.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on February 21, 2018.
